name: Yesterday's Meat
source:
You fall for Kaori the moment she confesses. The romance is flawless, almost unreal. But inside her home, reality twists.

Beneath her radiant smile lies a secret too dark to bear. Will you face it – or fall to it?

[From [url=https://mogegames.itch.io/yesterdaysmeat]Itch.io[/url]]
